fusions.name: Wading Splash
fusions.desc: You kick up 3 spreading splashes, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance of [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled Hoof
fusions.desc: A full-weight kick that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistance, and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Water off the Withers
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 9 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrug and Plod
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you restore 8 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
